game.moveToPosition: Move to Position • Click/Space to Drop

instructions.title: How to Play:
instructions.desktop: Desktop: Move mouse to position fruit, click or press Space to drop
instructions.mobile: Mobile: Touch and drag to position, release to drop
instructions.merge: When 2 identical fruits touch, they instantly merge into the next larger fruit!
instructions.chain: Chain reactions occur when merged fruits touch more identical fruits
instructions.physics: Fruits roll, tip, and stack realistically - use physics to your advantage!
instructions.gameOverRule: Don't let fruits stack above the Game Over line for 2 seconds!

stack.title: Technology Stack
stack.intro: Merge Fruit is a full-stack app: a React game frontend and a Spring Boot API backend.

authRequest.title: Typical authenticated request
authRequest.step1: Resource server validates Bearer token against Keycloak's JWKS

signup.title: Login (Keycloak redirect)
signup.step1: App redirects to Keycloak's hosted login page
signup.step3: Keycloak redirects back with an authorization code
signup.step4: keycloak-js exchanges the code for tokens

login.title: Session refresh
login.step1: keycloak.updateToken(30) checks expiry before each request
login.step2: Refresh token silently exchanged for a new access token
login.step3: New access token attached as the Authorization header

protected.title: Protected requests
protected.step2: No credentials re-sent on subsequent requests
protected.step3: Resource server authorizes access from token claims
